definition: A continuous glide between two notes in which the intervening pitches are sounded without interruption
example_context: Descent from komal Dha to Pa in Bhairav
notes: Sustained; carries expressive weight in its own right

definition: A brief grace note touching an adjacent swara immediately before or after the principal note
example_context: Touch of Ma before Ga in Yaman
distinguishing_axis: duration; too short to register as a note

definition: A forceful oscillation between notes producing a heavy resonant effect
notes: Prominent in dhrupad and khayal alap

definition: A slow controlled oscillation on a single note remaining within its shruti
example_context: Komal Re and komal Dha in Bhairav

definition: A parent scale used to classify ragas into ten groups
distinguishing_axis: classificatory framework not a performed entity

definition: The classification of a raga by the number of swaras used in aroha and avaroha
The progressive development of a raga in performance
notes: Usage overlaps with vistar; sources differ

definition: The smallest perceptible pitch interval in the classical theoretical system
The time of day traditionally assigned to a raga for performance
